column1: # Lane name-7 (fixed P1 [0x780fe, 0x7e540)): the shot-meter, results/scorecard,
# golfer-select and ball-HUD screens.  Rows: <hex addr>  <name>  <evidence>.
# Names are grounded in the decoded instruction streams, their callers/spawners
# and the data tables they consume (see docs/subsystems/name-7.md).

column3: first state of the pre-round ranking screen (not a shot meter), spawned by lea ($782c6).l,a1 + jsr $4c6 at $ea4e in demo_round_intro 0xe9e2 after leaderboard_rows_init when game_mode != 2: clr.b $10ebe2, spawn 0x7900e, install state 0x782e6; the four bytes before it [0x782c2,0x782c6) are the putt meter's scale table, unrelated (semantic-review-p1-782e6)

pre-round "YOUR RANKING" screen (no meter, shot or accuracy): palette stream 0x78b50[course], sprite map 0x78b60[course]; spawns the pose sliders (0x786a6/0x786e2, 0x787b6, 0x7883a when game_mode != 0), course sprites 0x78a3e/0x78a5a, record sprites 0x78a9c/0x78aa6/0x78ab0, sound $11f5; state chain 0x783ce -> 0x78566 -> 0x785d8 -> 0x7861a -> 0x7866a -> 0x78692 spawns 0x78aba, the place digits (0x78956/0x7892e/0x7890a, place from 0x73796) and the text 0x788c4; an A/B/C edge sets $10ebe2 = $ff, the end sets 1 (semantic-review-p1-782e6)

pose slider of the ranking screen (two entries 0x786a6/0x786e2, one body): frame 0x78bf0[golfer] palette $63 (0x786e2: 0x78bd8[golfer], palette 0x78c08[golfer]); golfer_id_p1, or golfer_id_p2 when golfer_id_p1 == $ff and game_mode == 0 (a lone P2 player, not attract); from ($180,$15e) slides left 8/frame to x $60, sort key $116 (semantic-review-p1-782e6)

P1-side pose of the ranking screen (not a P2 variant): golfer_vs_pose_lookup 0x6f632 on golfer_id_p1 (same $ff / game_mode 0 substitution), palettes a6+0x4e/0x50, slides from x $180 to $60, then sets the parent's +$11 = 7; draws via 0x7889e (semantic-review-p1-782e6)

P2-side pose (golfer_id_p2), spawned only when game_mode != 0: starts at x -$40 y $15e (the long $ffc0015e) and slides right to $e0; +$38 = 1 is the flip flag passed as d5 (h-flip), not a zoom; does not signal the parent (semantic-review-p1-782e6)
inserts the two pose sprite nodes: frame a6+0x4a palette a6+0x24, frame a6+0x46 palette a6+0x22, the second with sort key +$36 + 1, via actor_get_params_and_insert 0x73912 (semantic-review-p1-782e6)
typewriter for the string "YOUR RANKING" (0x78c14): one character per frame through 0x70044 at +$44, adding $20 (one fix column right); at $fe signals the parent and ends (semantic-review-p1-782e6)

place-digit actors of the ranking screen (entries 0x7890a suffix, 0x7892e tens, 0x78956 units): digit frames from the 10-entry table 0x78b70, the 4-entry suffix table 0x78b98 by min(place,4)-1; y $130, key $166, palette $d3; x-zoom +$34 grows by 4 per frame while x moves from start to final; not a gauge (semantic-review-p1-782e6)
sprite from the record 0x78b44 (frame $9f740 at ($a0,$160), key $11e, palette $d1) blinking on a 24-frame cycle (12 drawn, 12 hidden); static once $10ebe2 == 1 (semantic-review-p1-782e6)

static course sprite at ($e8,$15b): key $101, frame table 0x78bb8 (the same $9b8b4 for all courses), palette table 0x78bd0; the 0x78a5a entry uses key $102, frames 0x78ba8 (per course) and palettes 0x78bc8; no gauge, no attract mode (semantic-review-p1-782e6)
picks the course sprite frame table 0x78bb8/0x78ba8 by course_index $10d4b8 and allocates its palette via 0xb9a22 (called by 0x78a3e) (semantic-review-p1-782e6)
loads one 12-byte sprite record {frame, x, y, key, palette} (0x78b20; 0x78aa6 uses 0x78b2c, 0x78ab0 0x78b38) and draws it statically via 0x73760; records, not streams (semantic-review-p1-782e6)

loads the record 0x78b14 (frame $9f75e at ($a0,$128)); the x-zoom +$34 grows by 4 per frame and on the carry it signals the parent; one copy at x $a0, or two at $60/$e0 when game_mode != 0 (not attract); no flag graphic proven (semantic-review-p1-782e6)

pre-hole intro screen entry, spawned once per hole by hole_start_continue (lea at $eb66): loads the palette stream 0x7a436, spawns the fade-wait actor 0x7900e, installs 0x78c40; not a results screen (semantic-review-p1-782e6)

clears $10ebf8/$104fd0/$10ebf9, resets the sprite-area allocator (0xd0f6 draws nothing), loads the palette stream 0x7a430, bg_fill 0x79092, waits for the fade child's +$11 (not for input), spawns the driver 0x78d0a and installs 0x78c98 (semantic-review-p1-782e6)

ends on the driver's +$11, or on an A/B/C edge when $10ebf9 & $1f == 0; when those bits are set a press only sets $10ebf8 = $ff (fast-forward) and it keeps waiting; then sound $80 via 0x80494, the fade template 0xf42c and the parent signal (semantic-review-p1-782e6)

packs the hole kind into $10ebf9: outside game_mode 2 contest_hole_lookup 0x5aa76 gives $02 (longest drive) or $04 (nearest pin); in game_mode 2 match_holes_up 0x5a8ba gives $20 (P1 behind), $08 (|d| == 18 - hole), $10 (|d| == 19 - hole); then runs the wipe panels, board, text and per-hole sound actor 0x78f2a; compares no scores (semantic-review-p1-782e6)

three sound commands per hole from the 6-byte records at 0x7a280 (index course*18 + hole - 1): $1145 + hole - 1, an unknown word, $113f + par; no pointer stream, no -1 terminator (semantic-review-p1-782e6)
requests the 1-step fade (0xb9704 spawns the 0xb97d2 fade actor with d0=1) and installs the wait state 0x7901e
waits for the fade byte $104fcf to go negative, then sets the parent flag a6+0x11 and waits via 0x54a
identical variant of 0x7901e for the second panel slot (same body, separate entry)
identical variant of 0x7901e for the third panel slot (same body, separate entry)
draws the 20x16 sprite map at 0x23bf40 (bank half) through 0xd2ce at 0,0
right-hand wipe panel: x from -0x1c sliding +8/frame to 0x98, frame 0x88d64, palette 0x1c5, then 0x790d2
steps the right panel by +8 to x=0x98, then signals the parent and draws (0xf08)
left-hand wipe panel: x from 0x1dc sliding -8/frame to 0x128, frame 0x88db6, palette 0x1c6, then 0x79130
steps the left panel by -8 to x=0x128, then signals the parent and draws (0xf08)
the hole board panel: frame from 0x7a74c at (course*0x12+hole-1)*4, palette 0x1c7, then 0x7919c
interpolates the board from (0x74,0x180) to (0xd0,0x122) via 0x5707c/0x570d0 and draws it
golfer-select portrait: frames 0x88e7a/0x88e36 by the $10ebf9 bit-3 side flag, sounds 0x117c/0x117b, palette 0x1c8, spawns 0x7c6f2 and 0x792ee

leader portrait under the match-play standing banner 0x79204 (its child; not golfer select): golfer_id_p1, or golfer_id_p2 when $10ebf9 bit 5 is set (P2 leads); the id indexes the six 12-byte records at 0x7abac {palette, frame} x 2; copies the parent's zoom and slides from ($74,$14b) toward ($51,$14b) (semantic-review-p1-79204)

contest-hole banner (not golfer select or a name panel), spawned by 0x78d0a at 0x78e9c when ($10ebf9 & $1f) is 1..7: bit 1 (longest drive) frame $898f0/$88ebc and sound $1179, else (nearest pin) $89970/$88f3c and $117a; grows its x zoom while sliding toward ($d0,$128), then spawns the measurement text 0x79476 (semantic-review-p1-79204)

contest-result text line (not a golfer name): copies a 16-byte template into a6+$48 ("YARDS" for a longest-drive hole, "ft. in." for BIOS_COUNTRY_CODE 1, else "m cm"), fills in the contest_record $10d4e4 value (0x795c6 / 0x795d6 / 0x795fe) and tails into fix_text_writer 0x794e0 (semantic-review-p1-79204)
walks the a6+0x48 string and writes (addr,attr|char) pairs to the LSPC registers $3c0000/$3c0002 (0x20 = advance, 0xff = end, alternating attribute byte a6+0x45 bit 7)
decimal digits of d0 (divu #100 then #10) into d1/d2/d3 as ASCII, leading zeros replaced by '-0x10' (space); called by the text writers

longest-drive yards: writes d0 (integer yards, the high word of contest_record) as three ASCII digits (leading spaces) at a1+3..+5 and tails into fix_text_writer; does not call 0x59bf8 (semantic-review-p1-79204)

nearest-pin distance in feet/inches (BIOS_COUNTRY_CODE 1): ratio_calc_a 0x59bf8 gives feet (low word) and inches (high word); writes their tens/units at a1+1/+2 and a1+8/+9, then fix_text_writer (semantic-review-p1-79204)

nearest-pin distance in metres/cm (every country except 1): ratio_calc_b 0x59c12 gives metres (low word) and cm (high word); writes tens/units at a1+3/+4 and a1+8/+9, then fix_text_writer (semantic-review-p1-79204)

runs the byte script 0x7aad0 (the bytes spell YARDS, op3 sets the tile cursor, PAR, op4 prints the score, op5 stops): op bytes 0..5 index the 6-entry 0x7aab8 jump table and are jsr'd, every other byte is written as a text tile to $3c0000 with attribute +0x300

ops 0/1/2 of the 6-entry panel-script table 0x7aab8 (entries 0x796b8 / 0x796be / 0x796c4 set d0 = 0/1/2): return d1 = 0x7a9e0[course*$36 + (hole-1)*3 + d0], the hundreds/tens/units of the hole's ASCII yardage before " YARDS"; not the par (semantic-review-p1-79204)

op 3 of the 0x7aab8 script table: sets the VRAM cursor a6+$46 to $70a9 (column 5, row 9) and returns the next script byte in d1, a character printed there (the 'P' of "PAR ") (semantic-review-p1-79204)
op 4 of the 0x7aab8 script table: d1 = hole_par_lookup 0x58988 + $30, the ASCII par digit printed after "PAR "; not a score-vs-par value (semantic-review-p1-79204)
op 5 of the 0x7aab8 script table: returns d1=0 (nothing to print)

hole-number sprites of the pre-hole intro (not an 18-hole scorecard): three slots at a6+$40 {s16 counter, u32 frame list}: slot 0 list 0x7a6c8, slots 1/2 the digit records 0x7a560 + $24*digit (hole 10-18 shows '1' and hole - 10); positions from 0x7a98e (semantic-review-p1-79204)

hole image of the pre-hole intro: draws the hole record's +4 frame (0x5893a) placed so the tee (object type 7, map units / 20) sits at ($10c,$13e), x clamped to $f6..$fa, plus the per-(course,hole) offset of 0x799ea; continues in 0x79906; no player marker (semantic-review-p1-79204)

per-frame state of the hole image 0x79892: zooms grow by $10 per frame (forced to $ff by $10ebf8), moves toward the target; at full zoom holds about $a frames, then spawns the terrain close-up 0x79a86 at object 0's point on the image (semantic-review-p1-79204)

adds a per-hole x offset to the hole image target: key = course_index << 8 | the low byte of hole_number ($10d4bd), searched in the 4-byte {key, s16 dx} records from 0x7a86c (72 rows, dx -8..+5); not a player id (semantic-review-p1-79204)
advances a6+0x13 and draws only when bit 3 is clear (marker blink)

terrain close-up (not one row): spawns 0x79bd2, allocates 12 sprite columns, sets the palette streams 0x57a24/0x5922e/0x7a430 and writes SCB1 for 12 x 12 tiles of map cells around hole object type 0 (terrain_tile_convert of map_cell_query) (semantic-review-p1-79204)
zooms the board's tile block: interpolates to (0x9c,0x1e0) and pushes a 0xd510 task that writes 0xd3ec with the zoom a6+0x48
0xd3ec writer for the board block: 12 tiles wide, zoom a6+0x48, x/y from a6+0x30/0x32

child of the terrain close-up: palette $1c8, frame $88fbc, priority $fff, starts at object 0's point and moves toward ($bc,$1c0) with the parent's zoom (0x79c00); "pose" is not supported by the code (semantic-review-p1-79204)

per-frame state of board_closeup_child_actor 0x79bd2: copies the parent's zoom byte +$3a to +$3a/+$3b, places itself (zoom+1)/256 of the way from +$44/+$46 to (0xbc,0x1c0) (lerp_xy_toward), draws via 0xf2e

per-shot announcement, spawned by golfer_actor_spawn 0x54cb0 and 0x6db44 (attract_demo_index = 0): palette 0x7a44a, card 0x79cf4, one sound command from 0x7a240 (shot-1) or 0x7a260 (shot-par+4), +8 for P2; waits on +$11, sets parent +$11, ends in 0x54a
fills 16 columns x 6 rows from fix $71ab (x 13..28, y 11..16) with blank tile $ff via 0x7a110: clears the shot banner area

shot-announcement card: 3 sprite layers ($9da16 in palette $33 P1/$34 P2 plus two per-golfer frames from the 0x7abac records by record +1); slides from y $27e to $17e at x $54, 8 per frame (a button skips), schedules the banner 0x79eee each frame, holds ~$3c frames, then signals the parent; +$48 = banner index; $10fd83 (BIOS_COUNTRY_CODE) swaps index 0 to 7 off Japan
card exit: 8 steps of 0x79e66 (+$14 = $10..$80) shrink the zoom to 0 while the card moves toward ($106fd2,$139); then parent +$11 = 1 and 0x54a

zoom-in step: +$14 += $10; zoom +$3a = |word $54a3c[+$14]| - 1 ($54a3c = cos table); x/y move linearly from ($54,$17e) to ($106fd2,$139) by (+$14+1)/256; past $ff snaps zoom $ff, x $106fd2, y $139 and returns carry set; callers 0x54eaa (golfer zoom-in) and 0x79e40 (shot card exit)
returns the banner's top-left fix address $71ab - (y-$17e)/8 (row 11 of column 13 at rest); rows above the screen top fall below $71a0 and are clipped by the fillers

fix-layer shot-announcement banner: blanks 16x12 cells from $71a0, draws a 2x6 left edge ($6a0e), a 14x6 body at +$40 ($6812), the text row at +$23 (0x79f7e, $5400) and, for P2, a 2x3 block at +$160 ($6a6e); P2 adds $2000 to the tile bases; not a power gauge

writes 13 characters (dbf $c) from pointer tables: 0x7ab00 TEE/ND/RD/TH SHOT (status bit 7 clear, index clamped to 3) with the digit '1'+index two columns right, or 0x7aae0 FOR ALBATROSS..FOR D.EAGLE (bit 7 set); spaces skipped
sequential-tile block: inner loop +$20 (next column, tile+1), outer a1+1 (next row, tile+$10); a1 absolute fix address; d6 = top clip (rows above $71a0+d6 skipped); only caller 0x79eee

looping palette animation (spawned at 0x58502 and 0x58712): phases 1,2,3,4,0,...; each phase walks one 6-byte {slot, palette, -1} palette_stream_set record per frame; the $ffff marker ends the stream when $10d4d2 < 0 (no hole_band entry); speed bytes are phase lengths; game meaning unknown
phase tail of 0x7a040: +$1a = phase length, +$40 ($a) = delay before the 0x7a0fc stream (single-record palette streams, slot $3a = palette $148+phase)
decrements the phase timer +$1a; bmi to 0x7a044 (next phase)
separate routine (not an entry of 0x7a00a): fills d1 columns x d2 rows with tile $ff from fix a1 (+$20 = next column), clipped to $7000..$74ff

shot-clock '+1 STROKE PENALTY' banner (Spanish/Portuguese variants), spawned by shot_clock_actor 0x57658 at 0x5777c when the clock hits 0: palette 0x7a440, sound $11a7, two vram_tile_block_fill blocks, parent+$11 = 1, sound $11a6, string 0x7ac2e[text_language_index] one char per frame at $712e, then blanks 25x5 from $70aa and sets parent+$11 = -1
entry when the player's score byte $107082==1 and $107083 is set (from $6d2ae): raises the celebration flag $10ebfa and spawns 0x7ac7a
waits for the $10ebfa flag to clear, then signals the parent (0x598/0x54a)
plays sound 0x10aa, spawns the spinning actor 0x7ace4, waits on the parent flag a6+0x11
latch/step state for the banner actor (a6+0x11 handshake)
waits 0x3c frames then advances to 0x7acc8
signals the parent and settles

child of celebration_banner_actor: spawns the orbiting sprite 0x7ad74 (state 0x7adcc), sits at x $8f (no x slide), grows both zooms by $c per frame while y eases $181 -> $187; at zoom $ff sets the parent's +$11 = 1, spawns 0x7afec and stays drawing frames $8fa52/$8fada (semantic-review-p1-79204)

state of the 0x7ad74 actor: one sprite orbiting celebration_spin_actor and slowing to a stop (angle 0..$3b, 60 steps per turn, speed levels 0..$a); radius scaled by the parent's zoom; angle/15 selects a handler from the code table 0x7bce6; frames only from 0x7bcf6 and $8fbc8; position via 0x7af54 (semantic-review-p1-79204)

polar to screen: d1 = radius, d2 = angle 0..$ff, d3/d4 = centre; returns d1 = d3 + (r*cos(a))>>8, d2 = d4 + (r*cos(a-64))>>8 (table 0x54a3c, cos(i*pi/128)*256); not a point rotation; only caller 0x7aed2 (semantic-review-p1-79204, semantic-review-p1-7af54)

copies the parent's x/y/zoom and advances its frame (3-entry table 0x7bd32, counter +$50) only on ticks when the parent's +$11 is set (the wheel's step ticks), i.e. one frame per such tick, not every 3 ticks (semantic-review-p1-7af54)

hole-result award (no rank, prize or win): spawned at 0x6c03c (holed on a putt) and 0x7ad3e; sets celebration_flag = 1, takes the bucket strokes - par from 0x7b282, the sound record from 0x7b21e, spawns one award sprite 0x7b2dc (a second when d3 >= 6), then 0x7b070; +$46 is the game_mode 2 input-wait timeout (semantic-review-p1-7af54)

award wait: plays the +$42 sound once when +$44 hits 0, waits for the sprites' arrivals (+$11 == +$40), then blinks +$13 every 32 ticks; outside game_mode 2 there is no input and it ends at the second hide (~96 ticks); game_mode 2 (match play, not attract) accepts A/B/C edges from $10d515/$10d520 and waits up to +$46 = $348 ticks while $102ea2 is set; at the end celebration_flag = $ff, parent +$11 = 1 (semantic-review-p1-7af54)

score_pose_screen_actor's copy of the award (spawned at 0x7b426 when record +$22 == 1): same records with zero offsets, no slide-in and no sound; three 32-tick shows and two hides, a $5a hold, then parent +$11 = 1; not a "not placed" variant (semantic-review-p1-7af54)

picks the 6-byte sound record at 0x7bc9e {delay -> +$44, sound sent now, sound -> +$42} by the strokes-minus-par bucket, +7 when shot_kind < 0, the bucket is 2..4 and int(shot_distance_calc 0x59daa) >= $10 (the long-putt variant); no rank (semantic-review-p1-7af54)
d0 - 6 into 0x7bd98 (records 9..11 of the 0x7bd3e table: results +2 and worse), tail into 0x7b2c8 (semantic-review-p1-7af54)

d0 = shot_minus_par (record +2 minus par), forced to -4 for a hole in one (record +2 == 1 and +$22 == 1); with BIOS_COUNTRY_CODE 1, -3 becomes +4; bucket d3 = d0 + 4 selects the 10-byte record 0x7bd3e + d3*10 {palette, x offset, y offset, frame} (semantic-review-p1-7af54)

award sprite: slides from (0x8c,0x187) + the record offset to (0x8c,0x187) at $1000 (16 px) per tick (velocity +$36/+$38) via 0x57622; on arrival adds 1 to the parent's +$11, then draws unless parent +$13 < 0; no panel target (semantic-review-p1-7af54)

golfer pose screen, spawned by 0x6d4be (+$13 = 0) and 0x6d002 (contest, +$13 = 1); no input loop: fix_rows_1e_1f_fill_pal (50 Hz only), sprite-area reset 0x7b4fe, backdrop 0x7b5a2, then 0x7b4d4 + 0x7b5ee per player (P2 then P1 in game_mode 2); hold child 0x7b170 (holed) or 0x7b4ae; in contest mode watches contest_record_holder for a change (semantic-review-p1-7af54)
waits 0x64 then signals the parent (0x54a)
spawns the pose actor 0x7b7fe with child +$11 = golfer id (d0) and +$40 = x offset (d2); d1 is left as letter - 'A' for 0x7b5ee (semantic-review-p1-7af54)
sprite allocator reset via sprite_map_blit_wrap 0xd0f6 (vram_reset_all, start $20, split = end = $be); not a fix-layer fill (semantic-review-p1-7af54)

draws only when video_50hz_flag $102eae is set: 2 fix rows (y $1e, $1f) across 40 columns with tile word $c7f6 from VRAM address $701e (scanlines 240-255); no scoreboard bar; also called by 0x7fb2a (semantic-review-p1-7af54)

spawns the strip panels 0x7b908 from the 13 16-byte records at 0x7ba9a {palette, palette 2, x, y, script, alternate script}; one rng byte is subtracted from every x; +$40 is a script pointer (semantic-review-p1-7af54)
draws the pose screen backdrop: palette streams 0x7ba5c[course] and 0x7ba6c (course independent), map 0x7ba8a[course] through 0xd2ce with sprite x = 2*rng (SCB4 = d2<<7) (semantic-review-p1-7af54)
sets a6+0x11 = (d1 < 6) outside the attract title ($102eba==2); $11 = $ff for pose letter index >= 6 (G..L), 0 below, 1 in game_mode 2 (match play, not an attract title) (semantic-review-p1-7af54)

picks the pose letter from d0 = golfer id and the strokes-minus-par result (capped at +4, hole in one -4, long-putt shift) through the tables 0x7c10a/0x7c116/0x7c12e/0x7c1b2; d2 = $18 + 0x7bdfe[letter] or -$60/$20; spawns the sound delay 0x7b7c2 on the solo path (semantic-review-p1-7af54)

pose sound delay (not a panel): spawned by 0x7b60c with +$11 = the pose letter; waits $2d+1 ticks, sends 0x7c236[letter - 'A'] unless negative (B and C have none), then releases itself (semantic-review-p1-7af54)

spawns the pose: the golfer-specific part 0x7b8a2 plus one actor 0x7b89c per record of 0x7be16[pose]; inputs +$11 golfer id (palette list 0x7bdb6[golfer]), +$13 pose index (letter - 'A'), +$40 x offset, +$3c sort key (semantic-review-p1-7af54, semantic-review-p1-7fca6)
jmp 0xf2e thunk - the bare draw entry spawned per pose record

golfer-specific part of a pose: frame table[pose] from 0x7bfc6 + 6*golfer, drawn at the position of the pose's first record, using the parent's +$13 pose index; that it is the head is unproven (semantic-review-p1-7af54)

one panel of the scrolling strip (from 0x7b53e): palettes +$48/+$4a, script via 0x7b98e, follows the parent x + $44 (the parent scrolls left), wraps by $170 alternating its palette; restarts its script when pose_side_flag changes; runs 0x68618 (semantic-review-p1-7af54)
installs the panel's script (+$40, or the alternate +$4c when +$11 != 0, then at a random phase rng & 3 records into the script); not a blink (semantic-review-p1-7af54)

pose for the standings screen (spawned at 0x7478c with +$11 = golfer id, +$13 = min(rank,4)-1): spawns 0x7b7fe with the 4-byte record 0x7ba4c[+$13] {letter, side, s16 x} ('K'/'C'/'F'/'D'), its own +$11 = the side byte; then the strip panels and the 0x7ba38 tick (semantic-review-p1-7af54)
x scroll tick (installed by 0x7b9d2): +$14 counts 9..0, then +$30 (the actor's x) -= 1, so the strip panels scroll left 1 px every 10 ticks; not a timeout (semantic-review-p1-7af54)
